parties: Chandrakant Vallabhaji Gogri; Aarti Pharmalabs Limited
headline: Chandrakant Vallabhaji Gogri files SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure for Aarti Pharmalabs Limited
sum: Chandrakant Vallabhaji Gogri has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Aarti Pharmalabs Limited, a pharma manufacturer and listed entity.
implication: The filing triggers mandatory transparency obligations under the SEBI Takeover Code; the acquirer's intent, funding source, and any connected-party relationships must be disclosed to the market and target board within prescribed timeframes.
detail: Chandrakant Vallabhaji Gogri submitted to NSE a copy of the Regulation 31(4) disclosure required under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandated when a person crosses 25% or such other thresholds of voting rights in a listed company. The filing date is 22 June 2026. No consideration amount, number of shares acquired, or acquisition price is stated in the available document reference.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 4
framework.note: Open offer obligations triggered if acquirer crosses 25% or acquires additional 5% within 12 months when already holding >25%.
Shareholding disclosure norms and beneficial ownership reporting to Registrar of Companies.
Transfer and settlement of shares; disclosures in dematerialised accounts.

framework.ref: SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30(2)
framework.note: Additional disclosure requirements by the company post-acquisition announcement; material impact on control must be disclosed.
Director appointment and board composition changes following change of control.
